newsitem.title: USA: Arco,BP to develop Alaska's Tarn field.
newsitem.headline: Arco,BP to develop Alaska's Tarn field.

text.p: ARCO and British Petroleum Co Plc said they will jointly develop the Tarn oil discovery on Alaska's North Slope.
Tarn is located adjacent to the southwest corner of the Kuparuk River Unit, which is the second largest oil field in Alaska.

The companies said they expect field construction and development to begin in early 1998, pending issuance of needed permits. Initial production of 10,000 to 15,000 barrels per day is expected in late 1998 or early 1999.
They said a seismic survey of the field completed earlier this month indicated that the northern area of Tarn contains estimated proven and potential reserves of 50 million barrels.
